newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle up $2 at $104/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle up $2 at $104/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate, USDA said. Slaughter steers were $1.00 per cwt higher on a live basis, compared to last week, heifers not established. Dressed basis sales both steers and heifers were $2.00 higher.
Confirmed - 6,500 Last Week- 42,800 Last Year - 9,500 Wk To Date- 11,800 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 48,900 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 12,400
Buyer inquiry moderate to good. Seller interest limited except at the upper bid levels. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 65.00; Dressed basis 102.00-104.00. (weighted average 103.24).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 103.00, few 104.00. ( weighted average 103.08).
